items.title: Thomas Andrew Dorsey Interview, 1980-08-06
items.q: one thing that hurt me most, other than anything in life, except my mom can't believe God, when I heard that Mahalia's dead, I didn't know what to do.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. They were like Mahalia. In fact, they couldn't. Yeah. Mahalia had a style that they couldn't even emulate. So, one thing that hurt me most, other than anything in life, except my mom can't believe God, when I heard that Mahalia's dead, I didn't know what to do. I didn't know what to do. I wouldn't go home, wouldn't go to die, I think. I went to a funeral. You did it, yeah. I didn't want to see it. Well, she does not another Mahalia Jackson.
You may never. Well, you know, she recorded a whole album of just your songs.
